text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, you there. Can you be my
assistant for a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No need to be so on guard! I won't bite.
Now,
come with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki brings me to a girl who is
crying. I
understand the reason for her
tears immediately
when I see her freshly
scraped knees.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for the wait, my tearful pony.
Now the
show can begin. Don't blink, or
you might miss it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Behold as I cast a spell on this coin.
One, two,
three—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, the coin disappears
from Fuji
Kiseki's hand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your time has come, my lovely assistant!
Look
into your pocket and tell me what
you find!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Shhh! I'm impressed that you noticed,
but you
can't reveal my secrets!
choice_data_list: すごいマジックパワーだ……！

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, allaying the sweet girl's tears is
more
important than something as
frivolous as that,
right?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wow! How'd it end up there?! More,
more!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! How could I possibly ignore such
adorable
cries for an encore? Very well! I
will need you
once more, my trusty
assistant!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! "Magical powers," you say! I
quite like the
sound of that!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ooh, wow! Are you a magician, miss?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, indeed! And I can prove it!
Assistant! Go
ahead and see what's in
your other pocket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And what is it I find in my other pocket?
Another
coin, of course.
